full_name: National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (BLS National Longitudinal Surveys program)
population: US youth living in the United States at round 1; cross-sectional sample (6,748) plus supplemental oversample of Hispanic/Latino and Black youth (2,236); CV_SAMPLE_TYPE identifies subsample
age_at_first_wave: CV_AGE_12/31/96 = 12-16 (1,771/1,807/1,841/1,874/1,691). Age at round 1 interview: 12-18 per sample-introduction page; the cohort index page says 12-17 (documentation inconsistency; use CV_AGE_INT_DATE).
age_coverage_across_waves: Ages 38-44 at round 21 (2023-24) per sample-introduction page
baseline_sample_size: 8,984 round-1 respondents (6,569 = ~73% interviewed in round 21; retention 73.1%)
measurement_waves: Annual rounds 1-15 (1997-2011); biennial from round 16 (2013) through round 21 (2023-24); COVID-19 supplement 2021. Round years 1997-2010 verified on retention page; 2011-2023 from codebook Survey Year fields.
domain_identity_agency: Percent-chance expectations (YEXP; round 1 only for R age >=15 i.e. born 1980-81; round 4 all; round 5 split-ballot); round-1 optimism/pessimism items (YSAQ-356/357, R <=14); Big Five items round 6; TIPI and industriousness round 12; Grit round 16. No general locus-of-control/mastery item found in codebook title search (MASTERY/PEARLIN returned nothing).
domain_supportive_adults: Parent supportiveness (YSAQ-032 mother, YSAQ-053 father; later YSAQ-032.0x parent-figure loops and YSAQ-032_1/_2) 1997-2003, 2006, 2008, 2011 with changing universes; Child Trends scales FP_YMSUPP/FP_YFSUPP rounds 1-3; parent 'cares about R' 1-10 (2001-2005); who R turns to with personal problems (YSAQ-351A, includes 'teacher or school counselor' option) 1997-2017; domains of influence YDOM (2003, 2005; includes 'professor or teacher'); teacher items round 1 only (YSCH-36400/36500); school-to-work 'mentoring' participation (YSCH-33700 option b) 1997-2008. No item on a nonparental adult who made a positive difference was found.
domain_family_environment: Household parent-figure structure (CV_YTH_REL_HH_CURRENT 1997-2003; CV_YTH_REL_HH_AGE_2/6/12), parental monitoring (FP_YMMONIT), parenting style (FP_YMPSTYL), limit setting (FP_YHLIMITS), parents' relationship (FP_YMFRELAT), round-1 parent questionnaire.
domain_school_engagement: Round-1 school climate/teacher items (YSCH-36400 to 36900), absences/lateness fall 1996, 8th-grade marks, suspensions, school transcripts (1996/2000 school surveys), CV_SCH_ATTEND_* created variables.
domain_peers_community: Round-1 perceptions of peers (% of grade-mates who plan to go to college, use drugs, etc.); community participation/volunteerism topical page; household/neighborhood environment page (not read).
domain_psychological_development: Achenbach-type behaviour problem scales round 1 (FP_YYFBEHS etc.), Child Trends mental-health scale round 4 (FP_YMNTHLTH), MHI-5 (topical guide reference; rounds not checked), personality measures (rounds 6, 12, 16).
domain_transitions: Monthly school enrollment event histories, grade progression (SCH_GRADE_PROGRESS), HS diploma/GED dates (CVC_HS_DIPLOMA, CVC_GED), college degree dates, independence criteria, employment event histories.
domain_structural_conditions: CV_INCOME_GROSS_YR (1997-2003) / CV_INCOME_FAMILY (2004-2023), CV_HH_POV_RATIO (1997-2023), CV_HH_SIZE; program participation; geocode (state/county) is restricted.
outcome_postsecondary_enrollment_complet: CV_ENROLLSTAT each round; CVC_AA_DEGREE/CVC_BA_DEGREE dates; post-secondary transcript weight PSTRAN_WEIGHT (3,818 positive)
outcome_employment: CVC_WKSWK_YR_ET.xx weeks worked per calendar year; employer roster/event histories
outcome_earnings: YINC-1700 wages/salary in past year (1997-2023; top-coded top 2%)
outcome_wellbeing: General health item; MHI-5; mental-health scale round 4 (rounds for MHI-5 not checked)
design_strata_psu: VSTRAT, VPSU (round 1; refs R14897.00, R14898.00); Stata: svyset [pweight=WTVAR], strata(vstrat) psu(vpsu) singleunit(scaled)
design_weights: SAMPLING_WEIGHT_CC (per round), SAMPLING_PANEL_WEIGHT (respondents in every round 1..N), MORTADJ_SAMPWEIGHT; legacy SAMPLING_WEIGHT and CS_SAMPLING_WEIGHT rounds 1-2; NLS custom weighting program for multi-round subsets; PSTRAN_WEIGHT
access_level: Public-use (all main survey data); restricted geocode files via ResearchDataGov Standard Application Process (US researchers only)
access_cost: No cost (NLS Investigator and cohort zip). Investigator account is free and optional for browsing; needed to save datasets online.
access_terms: Public-use: no click-through terms captured during audit. Geocode: written agreement to BLS confidentiality policy, approved premises. AI/LLM-use policy for NLS public data: not found (not searched exhaustively).
download_url_head_test: HTTP 200; content-length 475,462,343 bytes; application/zip; last-modified 2026-01-23 (tested 2026-11-12). Zip contains .cdb codebook, .dat, .csv, .sas, .R, .sdf, tagset. Only the codebook member was extracted (range request) for this audit.
missing_value_codes: -1 refusal; -2 don't know; -3 invalid skip; -4 valid skip; -5 non-interview (verified on item-nonresponse page and in codebook blocks)
repeated_support_at_comparable_ages: YES for parents: identical supportiveness wording in 1997-2000 for youth living with that parent; R1 covers ages 12-16 (as of end-1996) simultaneously, and 1998-1999 ask only those <=14 at end of 1996, so each age 12-~19 is observed for several birth cohorts (accelerated longitudinal design). Universe shifts (lives with parent -> contact with bio/adoptive parent from 2006) must be modelled. NO repeated teacher/mentor measure (teacher items round 1 only; 'who R turns to' is a single first-choice category).
major_limitations: Support = parents only in repeated form; nonparental adults only as categorical 'first person turned to' (teacher/counselor rarely chosen: 65 of 5,395 in 1997); measurement universes conditional on co-residence (selective at older ages) and on birth-year group; round-1 expectations only for 1980-81 births and optimism only for <=14; 2001 split-ballot (TXGROUP) changes who answered; attrition to 73% by round 21; grade-progression event histories required cleaning per documentation.
verification_status: verified (nlsinfo.org pages + NLSY97 codebook .cdb extracted from official zip)
recalled_unverified: Common belief that NLSY97 has a mentoring/nonparental adult support question: NOT found (only school-to-work 'mentoring' program participation).

full_name: National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent to Adult Health
population: US adolescents in grades 7-12 in 1994-95 school year (school-based sample); public-use file is ~1/3 of Core plus High-Education Black samples
cohort_birth_years: unverified - needs manual check (not stated on pages fetched)
age_at_first_wave: Grades 7-12 at Wave I (verified); exact age range unverified
age_coverage_across_waves: Wave VI participants aged 39-51 (mean 44) (verified, About page)
baseline_sample_size: Restricted: 20,745 Wave I in-home; 90,118 in-school questionnaire. Public-use: Wave I N=6,504; II 4,834; III 4,882; IV 5,114; V 4,196; VI 3,937 (Data page)
measurement_waves: Wave I 1994-95; Wave II Apr-Aug 1996 (Wave I 12th graders not sampled); Wave III 2001-02; Wave IV 2008; Wave V 2016-18; Wave VI 2022-25
domain_identity_agency: H1EE1/H1EE2 desire/likelihood of college (1-5) Wave I; H2EE1 Wave II; problem-solving and 'worked hard for it' items H1PF8, H1PF18-21; Self Efficacy section (INHOME09, health-related, not inspected)
domain_supportive_adults: Protective factors H1PR1 adults care, H1PR2 teachers care, H1PR3 parents care (Wave I); H2PR1-H2PR3 Wave II; H1ED15 trouble with teachers, H1ED23 teachers fair; Wave III Section 13 mentoring H3MN1-H3MN13 (retrospective since age 14, relationship type incl. teacher/guidance counselor, age when mentor became important H3MN6); coded mentor function file mentor3 (MENTORA1-A8, MENTORB1-B8)
domain_family_environment: Relations with parents H1WP1-H1WP18 (autonomy, closeness H1WP9/H1WP13, cares H1WP10/H1WP14, disappointment if no college H1WP11/H1WP15); H1PF1-H1PF5 mother warmth/communication; household roster; parent questionnaire
domain_school_engagement: H1ED15-H1ED18 trouble at school; H1ED19-H1ED24 school connectedness/safety; grades H1ED11-H1ED14; skipped/repeated grades; Wave II H2ED analogues
domain_peers_community: Friends section, Neighborhoods section (Wave I INHOME20, INHOME36); friend IDs/network data are restricted-only
domain_psychological_development: Feelings scale (INHOME10), personality items (INHOME18), suicide, delinquency
domain_transitions: Wave III education/relationship/work histories; Wave IV educational transitions
domain_structural_conditions: Parent-reported 1994 total family income PA55; contextual/neighborhood files restricted
outcome_postsecondary_enrollment_complet: H3ED4/H3ED5 degrees Wave III; H4ED2 highest level Wave IV
outcome_attainment: H3ED1 highest grade/year (Wave III); H4ED2 highest level of education (Wave IV)
outcome_employment: Wave III/IV labor-force sections (not itemised in audit)
outcome_earnings: H4EC2 personal earnings (Wave IV); H4EC1 household income
outcome_wellbeing: Feelings scale/CES-D-type items each wave (sections present; items not itemised)
design_strata_psu: Restricted files: PSUSCID (cluster = school ID), REGION (strata) (Wave III weights codebook). Public-use design variable names: unverified - FAQ says the analysis guidelines refer to restricted-use variables.
design_weights: Restricted: GSWGT3 (W I-II-III longitudinal), GSWGT3_2 (W III cross-section or W I-III), Wave I/II Homewt files. Public-use weight names: unverified - needs manual check.
access_level: Public-use (subset sample) via Add Health Dataverse (UNC), ICPSR/DSDR (study 21600), or ARDA; restricted-use by contract (SRW or Home Institution)
access_cost: Public-use: no charge (Dataverse terms form; ICPSR MyData account). Restricted: contract (fees not captured).
access_terms: Add Health AI and LLM Use Policy (applies to BOTH public-use and restricted-use data): LLMs/AI tools (named examples include Claude AI) may not be used to manage, process, or analyze Add Health data; permitted only with public documentation, codebooks and study-level metadata. Restricted: no re-identification attempts, cell sizes >=10, PMCID required. Dataverse Dataset Terms form not readable from this machine.
direct_download_url: None verified. Dataverse (https://dataverse.unc.edu/dataverse/addhealth) failed TLS verification from this machine; ICPSR 21600 returned HTTP 403.
download_url_head_test: dataverse.unc.edu: TLS failure (self-signed chain via proxy); icpsr.umich.edu: 403. Codebook zips on addhealth.cpc.unc.edu returned 200.
missing_value_codes: Reserve codes by field width: 6/96/996/9996 refused; 7/97 legitimate skip; 8/98 don't know; 9/99 not applicable; '!' missing (observed in Wave I-IV codebooks; public-use files not opened)
repeated_support_at_comparable_ages: PARTIAL: H1PR1/H1PR2/H1PR3 (Wave I) repeated as H2PR1-H2PR3 (Wave II) one year apart, across grades 7-12 at baseline (between-person age variation); no adolescent support measure after Wave II; Wave III mentor timing is retrospective (age when became important, H3MN6).
major_limitations: AI/LLM prohibition means this project's Claude-assisted pipeline cannot touch Add Health individual-level data (human-only analysis or exclusion); public-use N ~6,500 and design variables unverified; Wave II excludes Wave I seniors; mentor item retrospective (recall, survivorship: only mentors remembered at ages ~18-26; H3MN6 range 0-25 includes ages before 14 despite 'since age 14' stem); codebooks fetched describe restricted full-sample files.
verification_status: partially verified (addhealth.cpc.unc.edu pages + restricted-file codebooks); public-use file contents not opened
recalled_unverified: Public-use design variables believed to be CLUSTER2 and GSWGT1 etc. (recalled_unverified); Wave I age ~12-20 (recalled_unverified)

population: Ninth-graders in fall 2009 in regular public, Catholic and other private US schools that included 9th and 11th grades; 944 schools
cohort_birth_years: Mostly mid-1990s; public-use X1STDOB bottom-coded at 1992 and top-coded at 1996 (exact distribution not tabulated)
age_at_first_wave: Grade-based (fall of 9th grade); age not a design variable
age_coverage_across_waves: Grade 9 (2009) to ~3 years after expected HS graduation (2016) plus administrative records to June 2021
baseline_sample_size: 23,503 student records in public file; 2,059 base-year unit non-response => 21,444 base-year respondents (computed from S1TALKPROB/X1STUEDEXPCT tabulations); NCES: 'over 24,000 students' sampled, 'over 21,000' responded
measurement_waves: Base year fall 2009; first follow-up spring 2012 (most in 11th grade); 2013 Update; HS transcripts 2013-14; second follow-up 2016; postsecondary transcripts/student records 2017-18; PEAR administrative records through June 2021
domain_identity_agency: X1STUEDEXPCT/X2STUEDEXPCT educational expectations; X1PAREDEXPCT/X2PAREDEXPCT; math/science self-efficacy (X1MTHEFF, X2MTHEFF, X1SCIEFF, X2SCIEFF); math/science identity (X1MTHID, X2MTHID, X1SCIID, X2SCIID). No general locus-of-control scale found.
domain_supportive_adults: S1TALKPROB 'always teachers or other adults in your school that you can talk to if you have a problem' (9th grade only); math/science teacher perception items S1MTCH*/S1STCH* (9th) and S2MTCH*/S2STCH* (11th; TREAT/INTRST/EASY flagged 'repeat of the BY variable'); talked to teacher/counselor about courses, college, jobs, personal problems (S1TCHTALK*, S1CNSL*); counselor/teacher helped with plan (S1PLANCNSL, S1PLANTCHR); S2TALKHSCNSL; S2REVIEWPLAN; S3CNSLCLG/S3CNSLAID/S3CNSLJOB; counselor questionnaire
domain_family_environment: X1PARPATTERN household parent pattern; talked with mother/father about college/problems (S1MOMTALK*, S1DADTALK*); parent questionnaire P1/P2 (involvement, counselor contact)
domain_school_engagement: X1SCHOOLENG, X1SCHOOLBEL (9th only); transcript GPA (X3TGPATOT etc.), credits
domain_peers_community: S1FRNDTLKJOB; S1TALKFUTURE (parents vs friends); other peer items not itemised
domain_psychological_development: Domain identities and self-efficacy; broader mental-health items not checked (unverified)
domain_transitions: 9th-grade entry baseline; X3HSCOMPSTAT/X4HSCOMPSTAT/X4HSCOMPDATE; X4EVERDROP; postsecondary entry X4PS1START; X4FB16ENRSTAT
domain_structural_conditions: X1SES, X1FAMINCOME (categorical 2008), X1POVERTY/X1POVERTY130/X1POVERTY185, parent education/employment; X1NCESID/SCH_ID suppressed on public file; geocodes restricted
outcome_postsecondary_enrollment_complet: X4EVRATNDCLG; X4ATNDCLG16FB; X4ATPRLVLA (Feb 2016); X5HIGHDEG (transcripts, June 2016); X6EVRATNDCLG, X6PSE, X6FRSTDEG, X6HIGHDEG (PEAR, June 2021)
